issues.claim: The BMA Dojo, 986 Amboy Ave, Perth Amboy (martial arts)
issues.problem: Wrong town. The dojo's own site places it at 986 Amboy Ave, Edison NJ 08837 and markets itself only to Edison/Metuchen/Fords/Woodbridge; no Perth Amboy location appears.
issues.fix: Remove the entry (or re-file it under the Edison zone).

issues.claim: Perth Amboy Martial Arts, 325 Main St, Perth Amboy, website perthamboymartialarts.com
issues.problem: Wrong town and wrong website. 325 Main St resolves to Metuchen NJ 08840 in the gym directory, and the cited domain now serves the Metuchen Martial Arts Center site with no Perth Amboy address. One secondary directory lists a Perth Amboy address at 358 State St, so the real business may exist but the entry as written is wrong on both address and site.
issues.fix: Delete, or verify a Perth Amboy location first; correct address to 358 State St only if confirmed, and blank the website unless the school confirms it.

issues.claim: Balance Yoga & Wellness Studio website http://balanceyoganj.com
issues.problem: Wrong website. The domain now serves unrelated Indonesian-language spam/article content, not a yoga studio. The business itself is still listed at 1160 Amboy Ave on Yellow Pages and a place page.
issues.fix: Blank the website field and re-verify the studio's trading status by phone or a current listing.

issues.claim: Perth Amboy Tax Advisors, 72 State St, (858) 205-5528
issues.problem: Not substantiated. 72 State St is recorded as a residential parcel in county/listing records, the phone is a non-local 858 number, and no second source shows a tax office at that address. It reads like a low-quality map listing.
issues.fix: Drop the entry unless a state registration or a second directory shows a commercial tax office at that address.

issues.claim: Rao Loder, Perth Amboy law firm (Martindale-Hubbell office page)
issues.problem: Not found as a Perth Amboy practice. The Martindale office page gives a New Providence mailing address and an address with a New Providence ZIP (07974); the firm is associated with New Providence, not Perth Amboy.
issues.fix: Remove the entry or re-file it outside the zone after verifying a Perth Amboy office.

issues.claim: Remedy Intelligent Staffing, 345 State St (staffing agency)
issues.problem: Excluded type left in the list. Remedy is a national franchise system (its own site calls it EmployBridge's franchise division with 150+ franchise offices), and the mapper already flagged it as a franchise. It is a branded franchise office, not a local independent business.
issues.fix: Remove the entry per the franchise exclusion.

issues.claim: Elias & Gonzalez, LLC, 602 State St, 2nd Floor
issues.problem: Probable duplicate. Directory records give it the same suite and the same phone (732) 697-1134 as Gonzalez, Tullio & Blache, and the same attorney names (Gonzalez, Elias, Tullio, Blache) - it is the firm's earlier or alternate name, not a separate prospect.
issues.fix: Merge into the Gonzalez, Tullio & Blache entry and note the former name.

issues.claim: Borderline chain / large-firm entries: Partners Personnel (313 State St), SportsMed Physical Therapy (271 King St), Ginarte (352 New Brunswick Ave), Garces Grabler & LeBrocq (502 Amboy Ave)
issues.problem: Not clearly excluded but poor fits under the chain rule. Partners Personnel is a multi-state staffing chain with one NJ office here; SportsMed is a roughly 30-clinic NJ group; Ginarte is a 30-attorney NY/NJ firm; Garces Grabler is a multi-office state-wide PI firm. None is a local owner-operated shop.
issues.fix: Keep only if the team wants multi-office brands; otherwise deprioritise or drop, and state the rule consistently.

issues.claim: Central Jersey Medical Center (275 Hobart St) and The Lupo Group (563B Amboy Ave, brokered by eXp Realty)
issues.problem: Both are flagged on the borderline of the exclusion rules and left undecided in the list. CJMC is a federally qualified health centre with multiple sites (institutional, not a private practice); Lupo is a local team operating under the national eXp Realty brand.
issues.fix: Make an explicit keep/drop call and record the reason, so the zone's list is internally consistent.

issues.claim: Absolute Access Title (316 State St) trading status
issues.problem: The cited website is an under-construction 'Coming Soon' page, so it gives no evidence the agency is open, and the entry itself says to confirm.
issues.fix: Keep only with a non-web confirmation (state title-agent licence or a phone check), otherwise mark as unverified and deprioritise.

issues.problem: The site is the right business (matching name, phone and services) but it markets Woodbridge/Sayreville/Edison and never mentions the 305 Maple St Perth Amboy office. The address is supported only by third-party listings (IRS acceptance-agent list, a mapping place page).
issues.fix: Keep, but record the address source and confirm the Perth Amboy office is staffed.

issues.claim: Coverage gap: several eligible Perth Amboy businesses found in my own category searches are absent
issues.problem: 9 eligible businesses turned up that are not on the list, mostly independent professional practices (two accounting firms, two salons, two PI firms, an insurance agency, a PT clinic, a pediatric practice). Overall my searches found 37 eligible businesses, 28 of which are listed (~76%), so coverage passes the 70% bar but the list misses real prospects in accounting, personal-injury law and salons.
issues.fix: Add the missing businesses listed under coverage.missing after a quick verification of each.

issues.claim: One Stop Insurance Agency has no website in the list
issues.problem: The agency has its own site (insureonestop.com) describing itself as a Perth Amboy commercial-truck/home/auto agency; the entry uses only a Bar List directory record.
issues.fix: Fill in https://www.insureonestop.com/ and note the truck-insurance niche.
